scope: Final coordinator errors in trial 3 and expansion trial 1 batch 1; excludes archived superseded attempts
evidence: Final results.json, recorded actor response for empty completion, current transport and coordinator source
findings: 224 of 232 failed episodes recorded HTTP 429 tokens/rate_limit_exceeded at a 1000000 TPM limit.
Transport makes six total attempts per request; independent backoff has no shared admission limiter or cooldown.
Coordinator does not requeue newly failed episodes in the same pass.
Five Discovery judge responses reached max_output_tokens after the actor submitted; regrading should preserve the existing actor submissions.
One expansion ASI actor response reached max_output_tokens.
One trial-3 actor response was marked completed but contained no usable text; one expansion actor request returned HTTP 520.
The 35-worker and 40-worker runs use different personas and different amounts of preserved work; their error rates do not establish a causal worker-count comparison.
recommended_next_steps: Add shared token-aware request admission and coordinated 429 cooldown before retrying failed episodes.
Replay failed Discovery grading from sealed submissions with a documented larger output-token budget.
Retry rate-limit, HTTP 520 and empty-response episodes after transport mitigation, retaining attempt history.
Review the actor output-token cap failure separately and document any budget change.
changes_made: Investigation report only; no inference, reruns, or runtime configuration changes.
